content: Downloading YouTube audio via yt-dlp violates YouTube ToS (civil/contract matter, not criminal) even though the yt-dlp tool itself is legal to use/distribute (2020 RIAA takedown reversed via EFF). A 2026 California federal court ruling held that YouTube stream-ripping tools used to download clips can trigger DMCA anti-circumvention liability, independent of the underlying copyright status of the content. Practical risk for a small hosted extraction service is account/IP bans from YouTube plus a nonzero DMCA exposure if hosting extracted copyrighted clips at scale, not likely a personal lawsuit at small scale but a real terms/DMCA risk to disclose.
